Cybord was founded by Dr. Eyal Weiss following a crisis in a defense mega project caused by counterfeit electronic components. It took his team months to trace the problem down to a three-cent faulty capacitor.
This incident, along with a deep understanding of the widespread issue of defective and counterfeit components, led to founding of Cybord.

The Cybord Deep Visual-AI platform aggregates and analyzes images and data from 100% of electronic components before, during and after assembly. By combining existing production data with unique, real-time visual data collection, it ensures product quality, authenticity, traceability, and end-to-end hardware security for OEMs and EMSs.
A future where AI empowers manufacturers to build products with uncompromised integrity — secure, traceable, and free from counterfeits or defects.

Secure the integrity of every electronic product by harnessing advanced AI to inspect and validate every component, ensuring unmatched quality, traceability, and protection against counterfeits and cyber risks.

An expert in technology development with over 20 years of experience in successful multidisciplinary research and development management. Eyal was the R&D department manager at the Soreq Nuclear Research Center, where he managed large projects involving over 25 experts before starting Cybord. Eyal is a specialist in entrepreneurship, from concept to product, and has won two Israel Security prizes.

Tyler York is the Chief Business Officer at Cybord, where he leads global revenue growth, go-to-market strategy, and U.S. expansion. He holds an MBA and brings experience across enterprise sales, marketing, and full P&L ownership, including time in the electronics and semiconductor ecosystem at Altium and Octopart, where he worked closely with engineers, manufacturers, and component supply chains.

Prior to joining Cybord, Tyler acquired, scaled, and successfully exited a digital marketing firm, leading strategy, client acquisition, and operational execution. He is known for his practical, data-driven approach to aligning product, positioning, and pipeline to drive measurable growth.
